confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city context, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident for a small, high-cost US tourist city. Bar prices (cocktail, wine) are less certain and are set from typical US mid-market levels. Hostel anchors are the least certain because Santa Fe has a limited hostel supply and dorm and private prices vary. Hotel anchors reflect a July peak-season premium, which is also uncertain. Tips are excluded from the meal anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized, tourism-driven US Mountain West city with price levels above Albuquerque and broadly comparable to other small heritage tourist towns in the region, with a summer lodging premium for July.
